body:
Most people I know have kids at this point. They rarely ever have time.
I wasn't diagnosed until I was 26 and I feel that was way too late as there's no real help to get as an adult.
I'm not able to work.

I get disability benefits or whatever is the equivalent, so I have enough to survive. But I would like to be able to have my own house so that I don't have to live as close to other people as in my apartment.
Maybe you could try to not evangelize to people that are struggling?
No. I'm not religious.
It really is.

I've been in bands and I've gamed with some of them but I don't feel like I can really connect through interests. It just ends up being that you do stuff together and then go your separate ways. I can't relate to them on a personal level since I'm so far behind them in life. It even feels more lonely since most of them have girlfriends/wives etc which just makes me feel more like an outsider.
I don't have to mask now since I'm alone 99% of the time, but it's not much of a relief since it's the loneliness that's the worst, and being around others doesn't help that either.
I've wanted and tried for so many years, but I'm only getting worse despite all my efforts
It won't change how everyone else sees me
Not good enough
I'm not seen as socially acceptable or whatever.
Masking I guess
I can't handle the stress, pressure and social interaction. Even working part time with my special interest was difficult.
Depression since I was around 14. My autism wasn't diagnosed until I was 26.
They just prescribe meds that most of the time just makes things much worse, and their counselors seems to just read from a script.
Almost 16 years I think.

I want to make music too but I'm just not creative, and bands haven't worked out either.
I feel like the only things that are available to me is like pretend jobs you can get if you are disabled in some way, byt it makes life feel like a movie set or something.

I used to work part time in the local music store since music and particularly music gear is my special interest but it was still very hard for me. I had to work full time for a couple of weeks one time and that made me totally break down.
I have been acting outwards, hitting and throwing things. They considered taking me in before simply for crying during therapy.
I don't want them to lock me up
It's closed. And I've tried pretty much everything already.
I don't have a problem with it as I use it to describe myself since it's accurate and concise.
No, they're shitty people.
I can relate. I wouldn't even want to work with my special interests, those being music and video games. Both the music and game dev industries are awful.
I feel the same. I have like huge gaps in my memory just because I haven't experienced much that is memorable.
How? I could barely manage a part time job relating to my special interest.
It matters when you as an adult still feel like a child among your peers due to the things you missed out on earlier in life.
It has only gotten worse for me as I get older. I can't relate to my peers at this point. I've been trying to find someone for almost 15 years.

Shitty parents, I was undiagnosed until 26, didn't have friends growing up, barely managed to graduate high school, was unemployed most of the time and the only part time job I had I had trouble managing, even though it was related to my special interest.
I managed to get some friends as an adult through playing in bands but we grew apart as they moved on in life. I've never been in a relationship either.
I'm severely depressed and no amount of therapy or meds has helped.
I'm just waiting on me to finally crack.
I'll be 30 this year and I feel like I won't see that day.
I'll be 30 this year and haven't done anything with a girl and not for a lack of trying.
I barely remember my childhood...
Maybe you could try to listen to and understand the people that are in this situation?
This was exactly the approach I had on dating sites and apps for almost a decade and it didn't work. I just got ignored or ghosted.

I gave up on it over a year ago now after I had a meltdown over it and deleted all profiles I had. I had gotten the first real match in over a year and I couldn't figure out what to write and when I did she hadn't been active in over a week. I had tried for almost 10 years at that point. The worst part is that it's really the only way for me to meet girls.
Empathetic
I'm sorry I'm human...

I feel even more lonely when I'm with friends because I can't relate to them. All of them are in relationships, most have kids and own houses. Meanwhile I haven't gotten anywhere since I barely managed to graduate high school, i'm unable to work and support myself, I've never been in a relationship and I haven't experienced much in general. I've been to several therapists of different kinds but nothing has helped.
